text: still not doing it, i even added some tile paint to make sure it maybe was just the unpainted terrain, nah, its just not seeing terrain at all [Image #1] you can see it catches flora tho, and build pieces, but no terrain [Image #2]
resolution: Confirmed against the exact saved Door_Wall_1 package: its mesh document is RJMD v1 and its atlas contains four translucent alpha-87 pixels, so glass and opaque leaf geometry share one legacy slot. The renderer formerly depth-wrote that entire slot before the dedicated terrain pass, hiding terrain while earlier flora and build-piece draws remained visible. The compatibility route now detects atlas translucency on legacy single-leaf-slot doors and sends that slot through the transparent non-depth-writing pass; version-2 split glass slots retain their explicit route.
